description: The finder takes unsolved problems and proven methods from every field, then searches their combinations for breakthrough potential: method A plus method B applied to problem C, with a predicted synergy mechanism. title: Combination search algorithm
description: The combination space is enormous; search is guided by problem structure: methods whose mechanisms address the problem's binding constraints rank first, and diversity prevents twelve variants of one idea. The search balances exploiting known-good pairings against exploring strange ones — breakthroughs live in the strange.

title: Failure modes: combination spam and synergy theater
description: The finder fails by proposing thousands of shallow combinations or by dressing up weak synergies in confident language. Defenses: mechanism-required proposals, synergy uncertainty reporting, and test-first gating — a combination that cannot state its synergy mechanism does not ship, and none proceed without a test plan.
